text: Bath shall hold a heated vessel at a set temperature with one controller that runs unchanged in simulation and against the wall clock.
rationale: The person asked for des as the engine of control software for something they build.

text: The controller shall fail toward heater off.
rationale: A controller that is wrong and off costs a batch; one that is wrong and on costs a kitchen.

text: The controller shall command the heater off within 5 s of sim time after the last sensor reading.
acceptance: T-SAFE-STALE passes: sensor silenced at 10800 s, heater off by 10805 s, under both control laws.
rationale: A dead thermometer reads as a cold bath; without this the heater runs until the water boils off.

text: The controller shall latch the heater off when a reading exceeds the set point by more than 5 K, and shall stay off until an operator reset signal.
acceptance: T-SAFE-OVER passes: a reading of set+5.1 K gives heater off at that step and no heater-on command before a reset injection.
rationale: A stuck relay or a wrong model must not be retried automatically.

text: The test suite shall fail when the controller reaches the set point in simulation in less than 50 percent of the readings it was sent.
acceptance: T-SAFE-STARVE passes: a controller ticking at the sensor period is detected as starved (fixture: max 20.29 C after 4 h).
rationale: Measured in the sizing: des signals are not buffered, so a 1 s tick racing a 1 s sensor drops readings and the fail-safe holds the heater off forever. Safe, silent and useless.

text: The controller shall regulate temperature within stated limits on the plant model.
rationale: The control law is the part that can be tuned offline.

text: From 30 min after first reaching set minus 0.5 K, the 1st to 99th percentile of plant temperature shall lie within set plus or minus 1 K, over seeds 1 to 20.
rationale: Sizing: bang-bang gives -0.56..+0.93 K, PI gives -0.08..+0.18 K on the assumed plant.

text: Overshoot on the first approach shall not exceed 1.5 K over seeds 1 to 20.
rationale: Sizing: bang-bang 1.01-1.06 K, PI 0.22-0.23 K. Most of bang-bang's overshoot is the assumed 20 s dead time.

text: Heater switch commands per hour shall not exceed the rated limit of the switching device named in the configuration.
acceptance: T-CTL-WEAR passes for limit 60 per hour (mechanical relay) and limit 3600 per hour (solid-state relay), each with the law the configuration selects.
rationale: Sizing: PI with a 10 s window switches 674 times an hour; at 100k rated cycles a mechanical relay lasts about 150 h. The device decides the law, not the other way round.

text: The controller shall make the same decisions in simulation and against the clock.
rationale: The point of using des for control: the code tested is the code run.

text: A decision log recorded under runRealtime with injected readings shall replay through run() to an identical decision sequence.
acceptance: T-RT-REPLAY passes on a 600 s fake-clock run with 600 readings, a dropout and a reset.
rationale: Reuses the Stopwatch harness; a log that does not replay is a story, not a record.

text: On the target machine, 99th percentile lateness of controller steps against the wall clock shall be under 50 ms.
acceptance: D-RT-LATE: 2000 steps of 10 ms on the target, lateness measured from before runRealtime is called, p99 under 50 ms.
rationale: Measured here: p50 0.64 ms, p99 1.6-2.1 ms on the lab machine. The target will be slower; 50 ms is 5 percent of a 1 s loop.

text: The plant model shall be fitted to the real vessel before any control-law limit is trusted.
rationale: Every plant number in the sizing is assumed.

text: A fit tool shall recover heat capacity, loss coefficient and dead time from a logged open-loop step response to within 5 percent on synthetic logs.
acceptance: T-PLANT-FIT passes: logs generated from 3 known plants with sensor noise 0.05 K and 0.0625 K quantization, each parameter within 5 percent.
rationale: Builds offline; the tool is ready before the vessel is.

text: The fitted model shall predict a second, held-out step response of the real vessel with RMS error under 0.5 K.
acceptance: A-PLANT-REAL: fit on step 1, predict step 2, RMS under 0.5 K. Unverified until a vessel exists.
rationale: The only leaf that says the simulation is about the thing. It stays unverified here, and the report should show that.
